name: CRBN Pro Team Backpack 2.0
description: The CRBN Pro Team Backpack 2.0 carries up to four paddles in a fleece-lined paddle sleeve and keeps gear organized with a ventilated shoe tunnel, a padded 15-inch laptop sleeve, and an insulated bottle pocket. A magnetic fence hook lets you hang the bag on court fencing between games.
care_instructions: Empty all compartments and spot clean with mild soap and a damp cloth. Air dry with zippers open. Do not machine wash or tumble dry. Air out the shoe tunnel after every session to prevent odor.
